body.message: We are not interesting after 14th December. Cos we will be in dubai from 25th of October till 1st of may . But from 17dec -12 of Jan. And also from 23 of February till 1st 15th of march we will have a holiday trip to another countries . So for us working or full of time ( 25 oct - 1st may ) apartment. Or from 25th to 17th December.
